image.name: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure
image.description: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure is a U.S. developer, owner and operator of high-density, single-tenant hyperscale data centers serving large cloud, internet, technology and AI customers under long-term contracts. Headquartered in Denver, the platform operates and develops campuses across Virginia, Arizona, Nevada and California and reported more than 1.8 GW delivered or under development, approximately 7 million square feet and more than US$5.9 billion of committed equity and debt by January 2026. Partners Group acquired control through EdgeCore Holdings, L.P. in November 2022 and remained the majority manager after a 2024 client syndication. GIC, OPTrust and Mount Elbert were the founding investors. Campuses, facilities, land entities and financing SPVs are not separate PortCos. No signed sale or later ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

image.name: Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC
image.description: Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC is a U.S. transportation-equipment leasing platform that owns and manages trailers and 53-foot containers and provides mobile-storage and fleet services under term lease and rental contracts. Headquartered in St. Charles, Missouri, the continuing platform operates through more than 30 U.S. locations following the 2026 sale of Milestone Chassis. Partners Group completed a co-control investment on September 24, 2021 alongside Barings, which had succeeded Wood Creek as sponsor in 2016. Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Wood Creek are preserved as former owners. Affiliates, legacy businesses, branches, fleets, pools and financing SPVs are not separate PortCos. No later parent-company sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

image.name: USIC
image.subsector: Underground utility network protection and locating services
image.description: USIC, LLC is a U.S. utility-network-protection platform providing public and private utility locating, geographic-information-system services, gas and water infrastructure services, inspections, cross-bore programs and vacuum excavation. Headquartered in Indianapolis, the company operates in 48 states, serves more than 1,400 utility and telecommunications customers and performs more than 80 million annual locates with over 10,000 employees. Partners Group acquired control in November 2017 and, on November 10, 2022, sold 50% to a Kohlberg-led consortium while retaining a 50% co-lead interest. USIC currently confirms the same 50/50 ownership. Earlier Kohlberg, OMERS Private Equity and Leonard Green ownership periods are preserved. Holding companies, financing entities, affiliates, regions, customers, utilities and 811 centers are not separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

image.description: 407 International Inc. is the parent of the concession company that operates 407 ETR, an all-electronic toll road across the Greater Toronto Area. Subsidiary tolling, financing, tax and service entities are included within this single parent-company boundary. No later equity transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.

image.name: AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc.
image.description: AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc. is a FERC-regulated transmission-only utility operating in Indiana and Michigan within PJM. The company owns high-voltage transmission lines and substations and is operated through American Electric Power affiliates rather than as a retail electric utility. Midwest Transmission Holdings, LLC owns the operating company directly; AEP holds an 80.1% economic interest and Olympus BidCo holds 19.9%. KKR and PSP Investments own Olympus 50/50, giving each a 9.95% look-through interest from the June 5, 2025 closing. AEP Ohio Transmission Company is a separate operating company and is not merged into this record.

image.description: Aerostar Airport Holdings, LLC is the private concessionaire and operator of Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in Carolina, Puerto Rico. The Puerto Rico Ports Authority retains ownership of the airport asset, while Aerostar operates, maintains, secures and modernizes the terminals, runways and commercial facilities under a long-term lease that began in 2013. Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR) owns 60% and PSP Investments holds 40% through AviAlliance. Highstar/Oaktree sold its aggregate 50% interest when the ASUR and AviAlliance transactions closed on May 26, 2017. The airport, lease, facilities, financing issuers and support entities are not separate PortCos.

image.name: FirstLight USA, LLC
image.subsector: Hydroelectric generation, pumped storage, solar and battery storage
image.description: FirstLight USA, LLC is the U.S. generation platform operating under the FirstLight Power brand. Its portfolio includes run-of-river hydroelectric plants, the Northfield Mountain pumped-storage facility, solar generation and battery storage across Massachusetts, Connecticut and Pennsylvania. Energy Capital Partners created the platform in 2006, GDF SUEZ/ENGIE owned it from 2008 to 2016, and PSP Investments acquired 100% on June 1, 2016. PSP signed a sale of the U.S. operations to Hull Street Energy on May 19, 2026, but the transfer had not legally closed as of September 1, 2026; PSP therefore remains the active owner and Hull Street is pending only. Canadian H2O Power and Hydromega assets, individual projects, subsidiaries and issuers are outside the canonical U.S. platform boundary.
